stem: A particle starts moving rectilinearly at time t = 0 such that its velocity ‘v’ changes with time ‘t’ according to the equation $v = t^{2} - t$ where t is in seconds and v is in m/s. The time interval for which the particle retards is

assets.alt: Graph of v and a against t in s: velocity v = t² − t (solid parabola, negative between 0 and 1) and acceleration a = 2t − 1 (dashed line, crossing zero at ½). The band from ½ to 1 is shaded: v < 0, a > 0.
